shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: A stylish, attractive Nigerian woman in her early thirties, natural hair neatly styled, wearing a fitted Ankara-print top, sits on a cream sofa in a bright, modern living room of a Lekki estate duplex, holding her smartphone in both hands and smiling slightly as she completes a payment. Through the window behind her: interlocking paving, a painted perimeter fence and palms. Soft late-morning daylight. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: A well-groomed, handsome Nigerian man in his early forties in a crisp white kaftan stands at the gate of his duplex in a gated Abuja estate, holding his smartphone loosely in one hand at chest height, thumb resting on the screen, relaxed and satisfied expression. Other hand in his pocket. Behind him: interlocking paving, a black water tank on a stand, a neat hedge and a painted fence. Warm early-evening light. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: tip
shots.prompt: Two elegant Nigerian estate committee members, a woman in her fifties wearing a gele and a man in his sixties in a tailored senator suit, talk warmly in the garden of an estate clubhouse, both with their hands relaxed at their sides, nothing in their hands, no papers, signs or written text anywhere. Medium shot: the two of them fill the middle of the frame, waist up, soft daylight falling on their faces. Palms and a painted fence in the soft background, dark green foliage across the bottom of the frame. Neutral white balance.
